title: Ngeli ya LI- YA (Theme 6: Bendera ya taifa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows nouns of LI-YA take li- for one and ya- for many (jiwe limeanguka, mawe yameanguka).
representations: stones, eggs and leaves in a basket

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Yai limevunjika" and "Mayai yamevunjika".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Jiwe moja ___meanguka." Kwa nini "ya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za LI-YA hutumia li- kwa umoja: jiwe limeanguka. Hutumia ya- kwa wingi: mawe yameanguka.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mawe mawili ___meanguka." Kwa nini "li" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa jiwe ni mawe, na kiambishi ni ya-: mawe yameanguka.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Jicho moja, ___ mawili." Kwa nini "majicho" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za LI-YA zinazoanza na ji- hupoteza ji- katika wingi: jiwe-mawe, jicho-macho. Nyingine hupata ma-: tunda-matunda.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya LI-YA?" Kwa nini "kiti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiti kiko katika ngeli ya KI-VI (viti). Jiwe liko LI-YA (mawe).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Jiwe moja ___meanguka." Kwa nini "ki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za LI-YA hutumia li- kwa umoja na ya- kwa wingi, si ki-, vi-, u- wala i-.
